_comment: Draft-screen crop boxes. Each box is [anchor, x, y, w, h] in units of the FRAME HEIGHT: anchor L = x measured from the left edge, R = from the right edge. The game scales its side panels with screen height and pins them to the edges, so one profile fits 16:9 … 21:9. Measured on a 1280x588 ranked draft frame. Tune with Calibration dump if needed; a copy at files/layouts.json overrides this asset.
